name: Manufacturing and Service System Design
description:
Manufacturing strategy, Manufacturing flexibility, Manufacturing complexity, Types of Manufacturing systems
Investment decisions using life cycle costing, Service Systems Design, Lot
sizing and inventory control models, Material Requirement Planning, Aggregate Planning, Performance modelling of manufacturing
systems, System reliability and maintenance models, Economic design of quality control plans, Single and
mixed model assembly line balancing, Shop floor scheduling algorithms, Production control mechanisms like Kanban and CONWIP.
